items.title: Announcement of prohibition of sound producing devices during the meeting
Approval of Minutes of February 7, 2023 Special Meeting & February 21, 2023 Regular Meeting
Introduction of New or Unfinished Business by Board Members
All matters listed hereunder constitute a Consent Calendar, are considered to be routine by the SFMTA and will be acted upon by a single vote
Requesting the Controller to allot funds and to draw warrants against such funds available or will be available in payment of the following claims against the SFMTA
Approving various routine parking and traffic modifications
Adopting a Resolution of Local Support for the programming of $34,277,000 of One Bay Area Grant Cycle 3 funds for the Central Embarcadero Safety Project
Authorizing the Director to execute Contract No. SFMTA-2022-37, Drug and Alcohol Testing Services for Taxicab Drivers
Amending Transportation Code, Division II, Section 801 to implement parking restrictions to prohibit parking on portions of 11th Street
Presentation and discussion regarding Vision Zero including a speed management update, 2022 End of Year Fatality Report, and traffic enforcement update
Discussion and vote pursuant to Administrative Code Section 67.10(b) as to whether to meet in closed session to discuss public employee performance evaluations
Motion to disclose or not disclose the information discussed in Closed Session
